name: IntraBalanceMovementCancellationQueryV02
definition: The IntraBalanceMovementCancellationQuery message is sent from an account owner/requestor to a settlement infrastructure to query for the status of intra-balance movement cancellation instruction(s) based on a set of search criteria or business attributes.|The message may also be used to: |- re-send a message sent by the account owner to the account servicer (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate") |- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy") |- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy Duplicate").
